name: band/step-status-vocabulary
text: Two more mismatches on the same vocabulary, verified 2026-09-07: STEP_WORD (PublishTab.tsx:862) maps pending|running|done|failed and has no key for either status the worker actually sends mid-run — so the in-flight step renders with no word, and a step the worker deliberately marked skipped (images, Lighthouse) renders blank too. The worker’s own comment says a green check for work that did not happen is a false signal; the guard fires and the editor drops it. No editor file references “active” at all. Durable fix is one shared status union imported by worker and tab.
